definitions.gloss: stationing of troops; garrison; military encampment
definitions.explanation: The act of stationing military forces at a particular location, or the state of troops being stationed there. Can also be used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: {部隊|ぶたい}が{駐屯|ちゅうとん}している。
{駐屯地|ちゅうとんち}は{市|し}の{北部|ほくぶ}にある。
examples.english: The garrison is in the northern part of the city.

examples.japanese: {自衛隊|じえいたい}は{全国|ぜんこく}の{駐屯地|ちゅうとんち}に{部隊|ぶたい}を{配置|はいち}している。
examples.english: The Self-Defense Forces have units deployed at garrisons throughout the country.

notes:
Composed of {駐|ちゅう} (to station, park) + {屯|とん} (to camp, gather). Used primarily in military contexts for the permanent or semi-permanent stationing of troops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駐屯地|ちゅうとんち}: garrison; military base
- {駐屯|ちゅうとん}する: to be stationed; to garrison
- {駐屯|ちゅうとん}{部隊|ぶたい}: garrison troops
- {海外|かいがい}{駐屯|ちゅうとん}: overseas stationing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {駐留|ちゅうりゅう}: stationing (especially of foreign troops) — emphasizes staying in another country
- {基地|きち}: military base — the physical facility itself
- {配備|はいび}: deployment — placing equipment or forces in position
